verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents a built-in natural-language chat AI Assistant for planning, prioritizing and optimizing your schedule. A Schedule Assistant suggests next actions, and you can preview its calendar changes before deploying them, so you can delegate scheduling work to an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which actions the assistant can execute on its own, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat assistant (community praise refers to auto-scheduling, not the chat assistant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
